title: carex pyrenaica subsp. micropoda
intro: Carex pyrenaica subsp. micropoda, commonly known as the Pyrenean sedge, is a plant species within the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is a low-growing, perennial herb that has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits. The plant is said to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing digestive issues and reducing oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are present in the plant and may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
